headline: 🍟 Hackers force hundreds of French supermarket fridges into defrost via Danfoss controllers, 🏬 Ahold Delhaize disconnects systems across three continents, 🔌 Ledger confirms hardware implant in reseller-channel wallets, 🛩️ Yandex loses three data centers to drone strikes, 🔧 GitLab ships 19.4.2 for CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE, 🧴 Rapuncel infostealer hides behind a Microsoft-signed EDR-killer driver
summary: An unprecedented attack drove forced defrost cycles into refrigeration at hundreds of French supermarkets via a known unpatched Danfoss flaw while Ahold Delhaize took systems offline in a separate incident, and physical-world damage dominated again as Ledger confirmed a hardware supply-chain implant and Yandex lost three data centers to drone strikes. Patch hygiene kept pace: GitLab published fixed builds for its CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE, SAP's October batch leads with a 9.9 S/4HANA takeover bug, and Bricksforge's CVSS 10.0 WordPress RCE is already exploited in the wild.

overrides.why: Scored 4.7 on a single BleepingComputer source, but vendor confirmation of a physical implant in reseller-channel hardware wallets is a rare hardware supply-chain event; elevated to lead-block position on strategic significance.

The Oct 13 witha.name configs pivot the DDoSia target list onto French state and municipal domains (knds.fr, rungis.fr, brest.fr, bordeaux.fr) the same week French food retail was hit; geopolitical context the target-list score under-weights.

Bench pick at 2.7, never covered: LastPass/Delphos Labs detail a Microsoft-signed kernel-driver EDR killer with a 145-product kill list behind fake GitHub repos impersonating 39+ brands, an under-ranked novel infostealer chain.

Bench-adjacent at 3.0, never covered: Varonis documents a ClickFix-delivered loader using Tox peer-to-peer C2 that survives infrastructure takedown, a resilience TTP the source-count proxy under-ranks.
